title: Network-based Spatial Context Retrieval for Open-weight LLMs: A Faithfulness Benchmark for Grounded Geographic Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.39437v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) encode substantial latent geographic knowledge, yet they reason poorly over space and are unreliable when queried from coordinates alone. Useful behaviour emerges only when structured spatial context is supplied in the prompt. This raises a question geographic evaluation has left unexamined: once the right context is supplied, does the model reason from it, or override it with its own parametric recall? We take up this question with an open pipeline for network-based spatial context retriev-al. In it, the surroundings of a selected point are defined by the pedestrian street network, the area actually reachable on foot. Using only open data and open-weight models, the pipeline retrieves features from OpenStreetMap and the GHS-POP population grid, computes indicators over the network catchment in code, and injects them as a compact spatial brief. On this basis we build a faithfulness benchmark. It labels every

translated_title: 面向开放权重LLM的基于网络的空间上下文检索：用于接地地理推理的忠实度基准
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）编码了大量潜在地理知识，然而它们在空间推理方面表现不佳，并且在仅根据坐标进行查询时不可靠。只有当提示中提供了结构化的空间上下文时，有用的行为才会出现。这提出了一个地理评估尚未考察的问题：一旦提供了正确的上下文，模型是基于该上下文进行推理，还是用自己的参数化记忆来覆盖它？我们通过一个开放的基于网络的空间上下文检索流水线来研究这个问题。在该流水线中，所选点的周围环境由行人街道网络定义，即实际可以步行到达的区域。仅使用开放数据和开放权重模型，该流水线从OpenStreetMap和GHS-POP人口网格中检索特征，用代码计算网络覆盖范围内的指标，并将它们作为简洁的空间简报注入提示中。在此基础上，我们构建了一个忠实度基准。它为每一个（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于行人街道网络的开放空间上下文检索流水线，并构建了忠实度基准，用以检验开放权重LLM在获得正确空间上下文后是基于该上下文进行推理，还是用自身参数化记忆将其覆盖。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an open network-based spatial context retrieval pipeline using pedestrian street networks and builds a faithfulness benchmark to test whether open-weight LLMs reason from the supplied spatial context or override it with their parametric recall.
